newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian exchanges oppose uniform settlements-SEBI.
newsitem.headline: Indian exchanges oppose uniform settlements-SEBI.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said on Wednesday it did not take a decision on uniform settlements for all exchanges after some of them opposed the proposal.
"It needs to be reviewed in greater detail," N. Parakh, SEBI division chief (secondary markets) told Reuters. "Smaller exchanges particularly were opposed to the idea."
The market regulator had on Wednesday, convened a day-long meeting in Bombay with officials of 22 exchanges across India to discuss uniform settlements among other things, to curb excess speculation.

Exchange officials argued that uniform weekly settlements would undermine smaller bourses which had no facility to carry-forward positions. Arbitrage deals was also necessary for the markets, Parakh quoted the officials as saying.
